content.snl: __list__(%Entry Tags introduce no registry, no per-tag entity, and no implicit inheritance from a Term Macro or a Term Macro Style.%(Concept.EntryTagNon-goals), %They also introduce no batch rewrite, no storage topology change, and no migration claim; this is an additive optional field under the existing envelope and version.%(Concept.EntryTagNon-goals), %Malformed present tags are rejected before any byte is published, leaving the workspace unchanged.%(Concept.EntryTagNon-goals))
